verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents the full loop. Broadcasts queue a message to defined recipients at a time you specify, which covers send and schedule. Emails are composed in a drag-and-drop or code editor and in Design Studio. Audiences come from Segments, and broadcasts can also be triggered via the App API or created as one-time sends through MCP. An early user independently praised its workflow building and previewing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of selecting a segment as a broadcast's audience, and hands-on corroboration of the compose-to-send campaign flow specifically.
